notes.title: Classified: Trailer Update status.
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108049/16f6f39cc3ca85b42656f2bc65315f1de7e912d8.png[TOP SECRET]

Subject: Status Update: Trailer Development

Date: 08/03/2024

Classification Level: Delta

Summary:
Attention. The development of the game’s first trailer is officially underway. Our goal is to create a trailer that accurately represents the in-game graphics, avoiding the common pitfall of trailers that look nothing like the final product. That's not who we are, and it’s something we refuse to do. At Nurbs Studios, our mission is to earn your trust through transparency and by offering our game at a fair indie price.

Additionally, we're leveraging AI to assist with translations into multiple languages. Our aim is to reach gamers across the globe and ensure that this information is accessible in various tongues. We apologize in advance for any mistranslations and appreciate your understanding.

Details:
Our focus is to provide a genuine glimpse into the game’s atmosphere and experience, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in its visuals and essence.

Objective:
To build and maintain consumer trust through transparency and active communication within the gaming industry.

Current Status: 
In Progress

Script: 
Trailer script completed

Visual Assets: 
Currently being fine-tuned

Timeline:
We aim to complete the trailer within the next two to three months.

Action Items:
Continue refining visual elements.

Links to Social Media:

End of Report
